newsitem.title: CHINA: China says black box of air crash found.
newsitem.headline: China says black box of air crash found.

text.p: Chinese rescue workers have found the black box aboard an ill-fated China Southern Airlines Boeing 737 that crashed while landing in the southern city of Shenzhen, a city government official said on Friday.
The cause of the crash, which happened during a thunderstorm on Thursday evening, is still unknown.
"The black box was found this morning," the official said by telephone. The airport was reopened at 9.15 a.m. (0115 GMT).
Flight CZ3456, carrying 65 passengers and nine crew, was on a scheduled route from the southwestern city of Chongqing to Shenzhen, on the Chinese border with Hong Kong, when the accident occurred.

Thirty-five people were killed and another 35 injured when the aircraft crashed and burst into flames in Shenzhen late on Thursday, the official said. The conditions of the remaining four were not known.
"The accident happened during landing," said the official who asked not to be identified. The cause of the crash is under investigation.
